tasks.title: Fix Simulation Validator
tasks.description: Simulation validator (sim:validate) reports all 18 simulations as invalid because it expects flat folder structure with request.json, response.json directly in simulation root, but actual simulations use step-based folder structure (e.g., agent-analyze/4/)
tasks.expectedOutcome: Either fix validator to handle step-based simulations OR document the expected structure mismatch with owner assignment
